Her medical records state that the date of receipt for the records was 2nd March. Jennifer tells Derek that he sacrificed Paige in the roots of the Nemeton "a few months" earlier. Derek was confirmed by Peter to be a sophomore aged 15 when he killed Paige. In California, students are born between 2nd September and 1st September within their school years, to be a sophomore no later than the 2000-2001 school year, Derek would have to be born between 9/02/1984 and 9/01/1985. Derek was also confirmed to not be a minor when he first met Kate through an interview with Jeff Davis, meaning he was at least 18. The ID shown in season 1 was confirmed to be fake by Jeff Davis, meaning that his birthdate of 11-07-1988 cannot be trusted to be true. This means that Jennifer's attack occurred no later than 2nd March 2001, Paige died no later than 2nd January 2001 and Derek was born no later than 1st September 1985.
